footer: ABSI v0.1. Weights and anchors are a starting hypothesis, frozen for this version; any change creates v0.2. Rows tagged judgment are scored by the analyst from reported facts and are the weakest part of the index. Prepared with Claude, a model made by Anthropic, which is also the subject of one indicator (Anthropic's IPO valuation), so independently check the lab rows. Not investment advice.
gaps: GPU and data-center utilization: no reliable public series.
Token volume and price per token, revenue per GPU-hour, revenue per MW: not disclosed consistently.
Enterprise AI ROI and productivity (labor productivity, revenue per employee): not collected yet.
Forward P/E, EV/gross profit and reverse-DCF implied growth for Nvidia and hyperscalers: not collected yet.
VC and private funding flows, IPO failure rate, insider selling, short interest: not collected yet.
Power-queue delays and cancelled data-center projects: not collected yet.
Historical backtest against dot-com, 2008, Japan and semiconductor cycles: not started. Until it runs, the thresholds and weights are unvalidated.
Recognized revenue versus run-rate revenue for the AI labs: run rates can overstate a year's actual revenue.
changes_from_v0_1: CAPE value is now refreshed automatically from Shiller's public data (same definition, same anchors).

One new measured indicator, ig_oas (US investment-grade credit spread, FRED/ICE BofA), added to Capital flow / financing with anchors fixed in advance: 0.8 percentage points = no stress, 2.5 = maximum stress.
Weights, planned counts and all other indicators are unchanged from v0.1.

ig_oas.label: US investment-grade credit spread (ICE BofA option-adjusted spread, via FRED)
ig_oas.note: broad investment-grade market, not AI-specific; measures general credit conditions
